description: int main(){ int t1 = 2*3; return t1; } -- single constant-foldable binop.
expected_outcome: instr 1 becomes: t1 = 6 (assign). instr 2 unchanged (or const-propagated to return 6 by a later pass).

description: x = 5; y = x + 1; return y; -- reaching-definitions constant propagation, then folding.
expected_outcome: instr 2 becomes y = 6 after x is propagated into it and 5+1 is folded.

description: x = y*1; z = y+0; -- identity multiply/add simplify to plain assigns.
expected_outcome: instr 1 -> x = y (assign). instr 2 -> z = y (assign).

description: int x = 4; is never read before the function returns -- liveness-based dead-code elimination.
expected_outcome: instr 1 removed entirely (x is not live at instr 2).

description: Code after an unconditional return is unreachable from the entry node.
expected_outcome: instrs 3 and 4 removed (not reachable from B0 in the CFG).

description: if (1) always takes the TRUE branch -- branch simplification should collapse the if_false test, and the ELSE block (instrs 5-6) then becomes unreachable code.
expected_outcome: instr 1-2 replaced by an unconditional goto (or removed), instrs 5-6 (else block) removed.

description: if (0) never takes the TRUE branch -- the then-block is dead/unreachable.
expected_outcome: instr 1 folds to t1 = 0, the if_false becomes an unconditional goto L0, instr 3 (then-block) is removed.

description: The worked example from project-doc section 5: a=2*3, b=a+4, unused=99, if(1){printf(b)}else{printf(never)}, return 0. Exercises every core pass together.
expected_outcome: a folds to 6, b folds to 10 (constant-propagated), 'unused' is removed (dead), if(1) collapses to its TRUE branch, and the else block (instrs 10-11) is removed as unreachable.

description: while loop whose body assigns 'junk' every iteration but never reads it -- dead code inside a loop body, and a genuine back edge (instr 8 -> L0) that must NOT be treated as unreachable.
expected_outcome: instr 5 (junk = 7) removed; loop control flow (instrs 2-4, 6-9) untouched.

description: Stretch pass: a = b; c = a + 1 -- copy propagation should replace 'a' with 'b' in instr 2, possibly making instr 1 dead afterward.
expected_outcome: instr 2 becomes c = b + 1; instr 1 (a = b) then removable if 'a' is dead everywhere else.

description: Stretch pass: t1 = a+b; t2 = a+b -- same basic block, same operands/operator recomputed. Common subexpression elimination should reuse t1.
expected_outcome: instr 2 becomes t2 = t1 (assign) since a+b was already computed into t1 in the same block.

description: Stretch pass: x = y * 2 -- multiply by a power of two can be replaced by a cheaper op (y + y).
expected_outcome: instr 1 becomes x = y + y (binop with operator '+', arg1=y, arg2=y).
